title: Coordinator uses the Operations home to find today's work and jump to each register
why: The Operations home is the coordinator's starting point; if its links break the day stops.
before: A Coordinator login with a home office set. At least one open work order and one job exist in that office.

steps.do: Open https://operations.mghaiapps.com and sign in as a Coordinator user.
steps.expect: You land on the Dashboard. Your name shows in the top bar.

steps.do: Left menu → Operations.
steps.expect: The page heading reads 'Operations'. Four tabs show: 'Backlog & registers', 'Work intake & delivery', 'TPIA service lines', 'Controls, time & people'.

steps.do: Look at the counters near the top (New requests, Unscheduled, Clarification open, Ready to schedule, Critical, Report pending).
steps.expect: Each counter shows a number (0 is fine). Nothing shows an error.

steps.do: Click the 'New requests' counter.
steps.expect: The 'Work order register' opens. Press the browser Back button to return.

steps.do: Click the 'Report pending' counter.
steps.expect: The 'Job register' opens.

steps.do: Back on Operations, open the 'Backlog & registers' tab.
steps.expect: Sections 'Backlog', 'Schedule register …' and 'Assignment register' show tables (or say there is nothing to show).

steps.do: Open the 'Controls, time & people' tab.
steps.expect: Tiles for Recurring services, Contract exceptions, Attendance reconciliation, Timesheet, Vouchers, Inspector ratings and Recruitment are listed.

steps.do: Click '＋ New work order' at the top.
steps.expect: The 'New work order' form opens. Press Cancel.

steps.do: Click 'Scheduling board'.
steps.expect: The 'Scheduling board' opens.

steps.do: Click '🏢 Clients'.
steps.expect: The 'Client register' opens and lists only clients your branch may see (plus clients with no branch set).

title: Every figure on the Operations home matches the register it opens

steps.expect: You land on the Dashboard. Your name shows in the top bar.

steps.expect: A number is shown.

steps.do: Take a screenshot of each pair for the record.
steps.expect: Screenshots saved.
